-- REQ: LANG-1201 LANG-1202 LANG-1203 LANG-1204
module Main where

import Prelude
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (log)

{- outer {- nested -} still a comment -}
data Shape = Circle Number | Rect Number Number

area :: Shape -> Number
area (Circle r) = 3.14 * r * r
area (Rect w h) = w * h

greet :: forall r. { name :: String | r } -> String
greet person = "Hello, " <> person.name <> "!\n"

multi :: String
multi = """Multi "quoted"
line"""

main :: Effect Unit
main = do
  let c = 'x'
      x' = 42
  log (greet { name: "purs" })
  when (x' > 0 && true) $ log (show (area (Circle 1.5)))
